title: Fema / RBI | RBI (All India Financial Institutions – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026
description: From 1 April 2027, RBI requires demat securitisation notes for AIFIs, sets a ₹1 crore minimum ticket and prescribes rules for public offers and earlier notes.The post RBI (All India Financial Institutions – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026 appeared first on TaxGuru.
